input:
; Selectable, target-neutral storage layout derived from the ordinary type
; graph. Applications author capability-tagged policy and selection products.
; No unselected product or sum enters the layout.
(: InternedStorageEmitter (*))

(: storage_policy
   (* (: policy type)))

(: storage_policy_member
   (* (: policy type)
      (: member type)))

(: storage_policy_root
   (* (: policy type)
      (: root type)))

(: storage_policy_dictionary
   (* (: policy type)
      (: scalar type)
      (: dictionary type)))

(: storage_plain_field
   (* (: policy type)
      (: owner type)
      (: label any)))

(: storage_dictionary_target
   (* (: policy type)
      (: scalar type)))

(: storage_reachable
   (* (: policy type)
      (: node type)
      (: kind text)))

(: storage_type_layout
   (* (: policy type)
      (: constructor type)
      (: kind text)))

(: storage_field_layout
   (* (: policy type)
      (: owner type)
      (: label any)
      (: position int)
      (: logical_target type)
      (: representation text)
      (: storage_domain type)))

; Parent-to-child direction lets a boundary planner process the child before
; replacing the parent's logical value with a catalog-local child ID.
(: storage_dependency
   (* (: policy type)
      (: parent type)
      (: required_domain type)
      (: label any)
      (: position int)
      (: role text)))

; Reverse boundary metadata retains the logical field label, position, and
; target beside the stored domain used to reconstruct or selectively join it.
(: storage_projection
   (* (: policy type)
      (: owner type)
      (: position int)
      (: label any)
      (: storage_domain type)
      (: logical_target type)
      (: representation text)))

(: storage_dictionary_layout
   (* (: policy type)
      (: scalar type)
      (: dictionary type)))

; Local identity describes one storage catalog. Semantic identity describes
; equality of logical values and does not claim that local IDs are stable.
(: storage_identity_domain
   (* (: policy type)
      (: domain type)
      (: role text)
      (: local_identity text)
      (: semantic_identity text)))

(emits InternedStorageEmitter "types" storage_type_layout)
(emits InternedStorageEmitter "fields" storage_field_layout)
(emits InternedStorageEmitter "dependencies" storage_dependency)
(emits InternedStorageEmitter "projections" storage_projection)
(emits InternedStorageEmitter "dictionaries" storage_dictionary_layout)
(emits InternedStorageEmitter "identities" storage_identity_domain)

(<- (storage_policy ?Policy)
    (edge_snapshot
      ?Policy ?CapabilityLabel "interned-storage-policy-v1" 0))

(<- (storage_policy_member ?Policy ?Member)
    (storage_policy ?Policy)
    (edge_snapshot ?Policy ?Label ?Member ?Index)
    (product ?Member))

(<- (storage_policy_root ?Policy ?Root)
    (storage_policy_member ?Policy ?Selection)
    (edge_snapshot ?Selection ?CapabilityLabel "storage-root-v1" 0)
    (edge_snapshot ?Selection ?RootLabel ?Root 1))

(<- (storage_policy_dictionary ?Policy ?Scalar ?Dictionary)
    (storage_policy_member ?Policy ?Selection)
    (edge_snapshot
      ?Selection ?CapabilityLabel "scalar-dictionary-v1" 0)
    (edge_snapshot ?Selection ?ScalarLabel ?Scalar 1)
    (edge_snapshot ?Selection ?DictionaryLabel ?Dictionary 2))

(<- (storage_plain_field ?Policy ?Owner ?Label)
    (storage_policy_member ?Policy ?Selection)
    (edge_snapshot ?Selection ?CapabilityLabel "plain-field-v1" 0)
    (edge_snapshot ?Selection ?OwnerLabel ?Owner 1)
    (edge_snapshot ?Selection ?PositionLabel ?Position 2)
    (edge_snapshot ?Owner ?Label ?Target ?Position))

(<- (storage_dictionary_target ?Policy ?Scalar)
    (storage_policy_dictionary ?Policy ?Scalar ?Dictionary))

(<- (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Root "product")
    (storage_policy_root ?Policy ?Root)
    (product ?Root))

(<- (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Root "sum")
    (storage_policy_root ?Policy ?Root)
    (sum ?Root))

(<- (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Child "product")
    (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Parent ?ParentKind)
    (edge_snapshot ?Parent ?Label ?Child ?Position)
    (product ?Child)
    (not (storage_plain_field ?Policy ?Parent ?Label)))

(<- (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Child "sum")
    (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Parent ?ParentKind)
    (edge_snapshot ?Parent ?Label ?Child ?Position)
    (sum ?Child)
    (not (storage_plain_field ?Policy ?Parent ?Label)))

(<- (storage_type_layout ?Policy ?Type ?Kind)
    (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Type ?Kind))

(<- (storage_field_layout
       ?Policy ?Owner ?Label ?Position ?Target
       "reference-local-id" ?Target)
    (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Owner ?OwnerKind)
    (edge_snapshot ?Owner ?Label ?Target ?Position)
    (product ?Target)
    (not (storage_plain_field ?Policy ?Owner ?Label)))

(<- (storage_field_layout
       ?Policy ?Owner ?Label ?Position ?Target
       "reference-local-id" ?Target)
    (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Owner ?OwnerKind)
    (edge_snapshot ?Owner ?Label ?Target ?Position)
    (sum ?Target)
    (not (storage_plain_field ?Policy ?Owner ?Label)))

(<- (storage_field_layout
       ?Policy ?Owner ?Label ?Position ?Scalar
       "dictionary-local-id" ?Dictionary)
    (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Owner ?OwnerKind)
    (edge_snapshot ?Owner ?Label ?Scalar ?Position)
    (storage_policy_dictionary ?Policy ?Scalar ?Dictionary)
    (not (storage_plain_field ?Policy ?Owner ?Label)))

; A plain-selected field claims its own row. Without this guard the fallback
; also fires whenever no dictionary maps the target, giving two rows.
(<- (storage_field_layout
       ?Policy ?Owner ?Label ?Position ?Target "scalar" ?Target)
    (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Owner ?OwnerKind)
    (edge_snapshot ?Owner ?Label ?Target ?Position)
    (not (product ?Target))
    (not (sum ?Target))
    (not (storage_dictionary_target ?Policy ?Target))
    (not (storage_plain_field ?Policy ?Owner ?Label)))

(<- (storage_field_layout
       ?Policy ?Owner ?Label ?Position ?Target "inline" ?Target)
    (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Owner ?OwnerKind)
    (edge_snapshot ?Owner ?Label ?Target ?Position)
    (storage_plain_field ?Policy ?Owner ?Label))

(<- (storage_dependency
       ?Policy ?Parent ?Child ?Label ?Position "reference")
    (storage_field_layout
      ?Policy ?Parent ?Label ?Position ?Child
      "reference-local-id" ?Child))

(<- (storage_dependency
       ?Policy ?Parent ?Dictionary ?Label ?Position "dictionary")
    (storage_field_layout
      ?Policy ?Parent ?Label ?Position ?Scalar
      "dictionary-local-id" ?Dictionary))

(<- (storage_projection
       ?Policy ?Owner ?Position ?Label ?StorageDomain ?LogicalTarget
       ?Representation)
    (storage_field_layout
      ?Policy ?Owner ?Label ?Position ?LogicalTarget
      ?Representation ?StorageDomain))

(<- (storage_dictionary_layout ?Policy ?Scalar ?Dictionary)
    (storage_policy_dictionary ?Policy ?Scalar ?Dictionary))

(<- (storage_identity_domain
       ?Policy ?Type "structural" "catalog-local-intern-id"
       "constructor-and-ordered-fields")
    (storage_reachable ?Policy ?Type ?Kind))

(<- (storage_identity_domain
       ?Policy ?Dictionary "dictionary" "catalog-local-dictionary-id"
       "scalar-content")
    (storage_policy_dictionary ?Policy ?Scalar ?Dictionary))
